_comment: Your Lexicon tag label -> Billboard chart slug. Generated by `init` against this library's real tags, then hand-corrected twice - see the track-record session that built this for the full history. First pass dropped 5 auto-matches that claimed a broad genre tag (Rap/Rock/Dance/Club/Country) for a specific chart instead of a distinct chart tag. Second pass added the 5 correct mappings for those same charts, once it turned out this library actually has a distinct, more specific tag for every one of them - init's fuzzy matching had always preferred the generic tag, since rapidfuzz's token_set_ratio scores a single-word tag as a perfect 100 against a multi-word chart name (a strict subset of its words), while the correct, more specific tag necessarily scores lower just for having more words to match. Edit freely. Remove a line to skip that chart. Run `charts` afterwards to verify each slug.
